flat_directory_rules.exclude_basenames_note: General harness tests added to tests/ after the V18 review. They exercise the agent runtime, CLI, eval harness and inference adapter, none of which are part of EXP-SGCP-EMBED-002. The flat tests/ sweep was over-broad; pinning them by name keeps the reviewed surface exactly the 200 files the V18 reviewers hashed.

limitations: The entry receipt binds selected mode, type, and path metadata; it does not bind blob contents. The independently verified exact Git tree binds bytes.
The manifest intentionally omits V18 review and closeout outputs that do not exist in the pre-review commit.
The four exact historical-development paths override the general development-component exclusion only for those paths.
The manifest does not authorize launch-plan design or execution.
A later protocol version must refresh the inventory if its review surface changes.

selection_algorithm.candidate_path_rejection: reject ASCII control bytes 0x00 through 0x1f and 0x7f; Git forbids NUL; require every selected path to be ASCII
selection_algorithm.record_encoding: ASCII mode, NUL, ASCII type, NUL, raw Git pathname bytes, NUL
